current_decision.message: The esp32_bmp280_v1 board family only supports an external regulated power input in the range 3.2 V to 3.4 V. Supplying 5 V DC directly on the power connector is outside the supported voltage envelope and would damage the board or cause malfunction. Please provide a regulated supply in the supported voltage range.

clauses.text: The board has to accept 5 V DC directly on its power connector. I do not need USB data.
